title: On Lazarus and the Palm Branches
edition: PG 93; In Lazarum et in ramos palmarum (Khazarzar)
author: Hesychius of Jerusalem
blurb: Hesychius of Jerusalem's sermon on Lazarus and the palm branches, in a fresh English translation of the whole homily. The raising of Lazarus is the sign that Christ will raise all humanity; Zechariah's call to the daughter of Zion to rejoice is read phrase by phrase; and the hearers are urged to carry palms of faith, hope, and love and to become a holy temple for Christ.
first_english_note: Fresh English translation of Hesychius of Jerusalem’s In Lazarum et in ramos palmarum from the Greek text of PG 93. No earlier English translation was used.

text_history.method: Fresh English translation from the Greek text of PG 93.
